ctx: SUBTITLE M. DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES

l: The board may adopt any rules necessary and appropriate to implement the powers and duties of the department under this code and other laws of this state.

items.t: RULES RESTRICTING ADVERTISING OR COMPETITIVE BIDDING
l: The board may not adopt rules restricting advertising or competitive bidding by a person regulated by the department except to prohibit false, misleading, or deceptive practices by the person.
